edits.before: Glitterlance the contacts — the Pix angles double your poke and the chip is constant.
edits.after: Glitterlance out-ranges his short melee kit — poke him level 1 while your ADC farms it up.

edits.before: E-mark trades begin: Pix on the carry makes every auto a volley.
edits.after: At 2 your slow and Pix autos punish his spell-reliant trades hard.

edits.before: Polymorph online — their engage now has a 1.5-second hole where a champion used to be.
edits.after: Polymorph is up — you keep out-poking his weak, spell-reliant early kill pressure.

edits.before: Wild Growth online — burst math on your carry dies; the knockup punishes the divers who try.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance flips it — his dive-knockup with damage-reduction beats a single Wild Growth.

edits.before: Late Lulu deletes dives: poly the assassin, grow the carry, and watch their plan become a squirrel.
edits.after: Late you reclaim it: Polymorph and Wild Growth neutralize his engage-dive and peel him off it.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Whimsy banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — 11s down to 7s at rank 5, his only dash — no engage while it's cooling. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Whimsy banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
